subject: general
question:
Change the following from active to passive:
They were showing the movie at 7 pm.

options.text: The movie is shown at 7 pm.
The movie was shown at 7 pm.
The movie was being shown at 7 pm.
The movie has been shown at 7 pm.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They were showing the movie at 7 pm."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the movie" at the beginning.
